strategy: balanced independent breadth with bounded prerequisite lookahead

breadth_candidates.research_prompt: Independently source affine spaces, affine combinations, affine hull; distinguish convex from affine hull and avoid unstated finite-dimensional assumptions.
Independently source independence of events and of sigma-algebras or random variables, preserving pairwise versus mutual independence.
Independently source trace of finite square matrices over specified rings/fields; distinguish operator trace in finite-dimensional contexts.
Independently source simple-graph cycles/circuits and distinguish paths, walks, directed cycles and graph-theoretic conventions.
Independently source congruence modulo positive integers and modular equivalence; distinguish residue class and representative.
Independently research a separate measure/analysis branch outside recently reviewed concepts; retain source-specific hypotheses.
Independently research a topology or geometry topic with a new contextual meaning, comparing only likely collisions.
Independently research algebraic structures or logic with source-specific scope, avoiding hidden convention shifts.

deferred_target_clusters.target_query_normalized: integer divisibility by positive modulus and integer multiple
square matrix of finite order over a field

suggested_next_package.rule: Independently inspect sources and collisions; never mechanically certify candidate labels.

goals: Meaningful independent breadth across mathematical areas
Every accepted final formulation has source-specific mathematical review
All provisional or held content explicitly resolved or excluded
Screened noncircular dependencies and completed citation audit
Full independent reconstruction frozen before original mathDef comparison
coverage_and_stop_policy.note: Coverage threshold and freeze decision remain a separate explicit research judgment; do not infer that mathematics is exhausted.

note: Candidate queue only; no automatic mathematical research, admission, publication or freeze.
